title: UneceProcessCertification
description: The process of certifying that a process has met performance and quality assurance tests, or qualification requirements.

applicableStandard.description: A referenced standard applicable to this process certification.

assertion.description: An assertion, expressed as text, for this process certification.

assertionCode.description:
The code specifying the assertion for this process certification, such as a claim that the process is free from child
labour.

relatedLocation.description: A referenced location related to this process certification.

responsibleAgency.description: An agency, expressed as text, responsible for this process certification.

specifiedAssertion.description: A sustainability assertion specified for this process certification.

standard.description: A standard, expressed as text, used for this process certification.
